    The Role

    We're looking for a strategic, data-driven Head of VIP to own the design, performance, and continuous optimization of our VIP retention program across T1 and T2 casino markets. You'll set the strategy, bring innovation, novel ideas, own the numbers, and lead through a dedicated VIP Team Leader who runs day-to-day execution. You'll spend your time on segmentation, cohort analysis, program design, and cross-functional influence, stepping into the player-facing world only for your top 10–20 Tier-1 accounts and genuine crisis escalations.

     

    What You'll Own

    • Strategic Analytics: Design and maintain our multi-tier segmentation (Mass Market / Pre-VIP / VIP) and cohort framework (Active, Churn, Reactivated, New), and deliver 7-day, 14-day, and monthly performance intelligence across every project and market.
    • Program Strategy and Tactics: Own the annual VIP Retention Marketing Calendar — campaign design, offer mechanics, seasonal activations, and a structured testing roadmap.
    • Retention & Reactivation: Build predictive churn early-warning capability, design win-back mechanics, and personally step in on high-stakes closure situations escalated by your Team Leader.
    • Business Performance: Own retention rate, churn reactivation, NGR/deposit growth, LTV, bonus efficiency ratio, and surplus margin — and report on them monthly to leadership.
    • Cross-Functional Leadership: Partner with Product, Marketing, CRM, Compliance, and Finance to keep VIP strategy aligned with the wider business, and represent the segment at board level.
    • Team Leadership: Set the department's KPI framework and give strategic direction to your VIP Team Leader — who owns scheduling, coaching, QA, and the day-to-day player relationship.

     

    What We're Looking For

    • Proven track record building or scaling a VIP program in iGaming/gambling, ideally across regulated T1/T2 markets.
    • Fluency with the metrics that actually run a VIP book: NGR (not just GGR), cohort-based LTV, LTV:CAC, bonus efficiency, and surplus margin.
    • Experience leading through a manager layer rather than running a desk personally — comfortable setting direction and holding a Team Leader accountable to KPIs, not doing the coaching yourself.
    • Strong cross-functional influence — you've shaped Product, Marketing, and Compliance decisions with data, not just requested changes.
    • Working knowledge of the regulatory constraints that shape VIP marketing in T1/T2 markets (e.g. UK affordability checks, MGA/EU advertising rules, responsible gambling obligations).

     

    🎓 Education & Experience:

    • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field.
    • A minimum of 3 years of experience in VIP management or a similar role, with at least 2 years in a leadership position.

     

    🌍 Why You Should Join Us

    • Competitive Compensation: Enjoy a highly competitive salary and performance-based bonuses.
    • Remote Flexibility: Work from anywhere as part of an international and geographically diverse team.
    • Professional Growth: We invest in your career development with ample opportunities for learning and growth.
    • Exciting Challenges: Join a forward-thinking, fast-growing company at the forefront of the iGaming industry.

     

    Ready to take your VIP expertise to the next level? Apply now and help us redefine the VIP experience, shape the future of player engagement, and make a lasting impact in the iGaming world.

    Title: Product Owner
    Reports to: Associate Director, DevOps
    Department: DevOps
    Location: Kyiv, Ukraine – Remote
    Term: Full-Time

     

    About Atlas Technica

    Atlas Technica’s mission is to shoulder IT management, user support, and cybersecurity for our clients, who are hedge funds and other investment firms. Founded in 2016, we have grown year over year through our uncompromising focus on service.

    We value ownership, execution, growth, intelligence, and camaraderie. We are looking for people who share our Core Values, thrive, and contribute to this environment while putting the customer first. At Atlas Technica, we offer a competitive salary, comprehensive benefits, and great perks to our global Team. We strive to maintain a professional yet friendly environment while promoting professional and career development for our Team Members. Join Atlas Technica now!

     

    Position Overview

    We are seeking a Product Owner to join our DevOps team and help shape the continued development of Atlas Technica’s internal and client-facing technology platforms.

    As a Product Owner, you will define the vision, roadmap, and priorities for key platform services, balancing customer value, business objectives, and technical considerations to drive product success.

    The Product Owner will lead product discovery, translate validated opportunities into clear requirements and measurable outcomes, manage and prioritize the product backlog, and work closely with Engineering, Quality Assurance, Customer Support, and other stakeholders throughout the product lifecycle.

    The successful candidate will combine strong product ownership experience with analytical thinking, customer empathy, clear communication, and the ability to make thoughtful, evidence-based decisions across competing priorities, technical constraints, and available capacity.

     

    Position Responsibilities:

    • Own and prioritize the product backlog for assigned SaaS platform services, including areas such as connectivity, authentication and authorization, APIs and integrations, workflow services, and notification systems
    • Develop and maintain a comprehensive understanding of assigned products, users, existing functionality, business processes, technical constraints, company standards, roadmap, and intended future state
    • Lead product discovery activities, including customer interviews, Customer Support shadowing, research, and hypothesis validation to identify customer needs, pain points, and product opportunities
    • Contribute to product strategy, roadmap development, quarterly planning, and prioritization decisions
    • Evaluate incoming requests based on customer value, business impact, product strategy, current capabilities, risks, dependencies, planned improvements, and available capacity
    • Translate validated product opportunities into clear requirements, use cases, user stories, acceptance criteria, priorities, and measurable outcomes
    • Collaborate closely with Engineering, Quality Assurance, Customer Support, and other stakeholders throughout product discovery, development, delivery, and continuous improvement
    • Define and monitor product KPIs to evaluate usage, adoption, customer behavior, and product outcomes
    • Combine quantitative data with customer and stakeholder feedback to identify product gaps, improve adoption, and inform roadmap decisions
    • Balance competing stakeholder priorities and make transparent, evidence-based product decisions within the role’s delegated authority
    • Clearly communicate product priorities, decisions, trade-offs, roadmap changes, results, and supporting rationale to technical and non-technical audiences
    • Support successful product changes through internal education, demonstrations, stakeholder communication, and timely follow-through on assigned actions

     

    Requirements:

    • 5+ years of experience in product ownership, product management, or a closely related role, preferably within a SaaS or technology environment
    • Proven experience owning the product lifecycle from discovery and roadmap development through backlog prioritization, delivery, launch, measurement, and continuous improvement
    • Strong product discovery skills, including customer interviews, market research, competitor analysis, and hypothesis validation
    • Ability to translate business objectives and user needs into clear product requirements, use cases, user stories, acceptance criteria, priorities, and measurable outcomes
    • Strong analytical and data-driven decision-making skills, including experience defining and tracking product KPIs
    • Experience analyzing product adoption, funnels, retention, conversion, churn, or other relevant performance indicators
    • Experience with A/B testing, product experimentation, and metrics-based evaluation
    • Strong stakeholder-management and risk-management skills with the ability to balance competing priorities across multiple teams
    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders
    • Advanced English proficiency at C1 level or higher for collaboration with international teams and stakeholders
    • Experience using AI tools for research, analysis, prototyping, workflow automation, or other product-management activities

     

    Desirable Qualities:

    • Experience working within or supporting the Managed Service Provider industry, particularly organizations serving the U.S. market
    • Experience working within complex corporate environments and collaborating across multiple teams and stakeholder groups
    • Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO), Professional Scrum Product Owner (PSPO), or comparable product or Agile certification
    • Familiarity with product analytics platforms such as Mixpanel or similar tools
    • Experience working closely with DevOps, Engineering, SaaS platform, API, integration, or shared-services teams
    • Strong customer-focused mindset with the ability to combine qualitative feedback and quantitative data into practical product decisions

     

    Atlas Technica is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

    About the role

    We're hiring a freelance content writer to produce the content that supports our inbound engine — website content, case studies, and guest posts on external publications.

    This is a fractional engagement covering the ongoing content output for our website and external placements.

    You'll work from briefs supplied by our SEO specialist. The strategy layer (keyword targeting, search intent, technical SEO) sits with them. Your focus is voice, craft, and execution.

    Our writing covers a mix of audiences. Business decision-makers — COOs, VPs of Operations, CFOs, Heads of Customer Success — are the primary audience for a lot of what we publish, since they're the people our sales team is speaking with. Alongside that, a meaningful share of our content is written for engineering leaders and developers: technical deep dives on AI orchestration architecture, modernization approach pieces, and articles that go into implementation detail. We're looking for someone who can move between these registers comfortably.

     

    Our writing

    Our positioning is built on being direct and specific. We say what we do, back it with numbers where we can, and prefer plain language to marketing padding. Reading our homepage is the fastest way to calibrate.

     

    Concretely, we tend toward:

    • Short sentences. Long ones are earned
    • Specific numbers and named companies where the data supports it. "24 to 10 people" tends to land better than "significantly reduced headcount."
    • Real perspectives, including honest tradeoffs and things that don't work as advertised

    • Plain vocabulary. Words like "game-changing," "leverage," and "synergy" tend to mean less than plainer alternatives would

       

    Ongoing engagement

    Monthly output

    • 4–10 pieces for our website: blog posts, product page copy, website copy updates as our positioning evolves, case studies, and other on-site content

    • 4–8 guest articles for external publications, aimed at reach and backlinks

       

    As-needed

    • Sales enablement copy: one-pagers, pitch deck sections, email templates

    • Other supporting content as offers and positioning evolve

       

    Not in current scope

    LinkedIn and other social content are not part of this engagement at the moment. We may add them later — if so, we'll agree scope and rate separately before starting

     

    What you won't do

    • SEO strategy or keyword research (our SEO specialist owns this)
    • Graphic design, image creation, or video work
    • Social media management, posting, or engagement replies
    • Paid ad copy (occasional exception; not a primary responsibility)

    • PR outreach or media relations

       

    Required

    • 2+ years writing for IT outsource companies serving the US market
    • C1-level English (or higher)
    • Familiar with Google's SEO Starter Guide and comfortable writing to its fundamentals (developers.google.com/search/docs/fundamentals/seo-starter-guide)
    • Comfortable publishing directly on WordPress — formatting, images, alt text, meta descriptions, internal linking
    • Portfolio that shows range across business and technical audiences
    • Comfortable executing from an SEO brief
    • Working understanding of LLM / generative search optimization — what makes content citation-friendly for ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini
    • Case study experience, including running discovery interviews with clients

    • Independent worker, reliable with deadlines

       

    Nice to have

    • Familiarity with operational AI, agentic workflows, or SaaS modernization topics
    • Experience with long-form interview-based case studies
    • Additional SEO knowledge — enough for productive conversations with our SEO specialist

    • Comfort with async, distributed work across UA/EU time zone

       

    Engagement model

    • Status: Freelance / contract. Not an employment offer
    • Term: Open-ended
    • Editorial approval: A single editorial approver at Ekreative. Feedback is direct, turnaround targets 48 hours.

    • Working hours: Your own. We measure deliverables, not hours

       

    What success looks like

    Six-month horizon. We'll review against these together each quarter:

    • Reliable delivery of the monthly output we agree together
    • Articles pass SEO review without major rewrites — readability, keyword integration, structure, compliance with Google's SEO fundamentals, LLM-friendly formatting
    • Content published cleanly on WordPress — correct formatting, images, alt text, meta descriptions, internal links

    • Voice consistency across pieces

       

    How to apply

    Send us:

    • Portfolio of your articles for IT outsource companies.
    • Your proposed monthly deliverable commitment and rate for it.

    Langate is an award-winning provider of web development services in three main categories: business, healthcare, and education. At Langate, we are passionate about crafting digital solutions that make a real impact, and we take immense pride in our strong collaboration with the U.S. market.

    In addition to professional expertise, we value excellent communication skills. Collaboration and effective teamwork are the cornerstones of our success, and we believe in fostering an environment where everyone’s voice is heard and valued.

    About the project

    You will join the team behind a large online store that sells durable medical equipment to customers across the United States, including products for people with physical and cognitive disabilities. The business is mature and high-volume, with active marketing and merchandising teams that generate a steady flow of new requests.

    The platform is being modernised step by step: it is moving from a legacy Adobe ColdFusion codebase to an Angular front end with a .NET Core back end. The customer-facing storefront went live on the new stack in early September. The admin area and several internal modules that cover inventory, supplier and service workflows are still on the old technology and will be migrated next, alongside new features requested by the business.

    Much of the existing logic is custom-built and only partly documented, so a meaningful part of the work is reconstructing how the current system behaves and turning that into requirements the team can build against.

    What you will do

    • Gather high-level business requests from client stakeholders and turn them into clear, buildable requirements for the development team.
    • Run feature kick-off and clarification calls with the client two to three times per week, prepare the questions in advance and follow up until the open points are closed.
    • Investigate how existing functionality works, form and validate assumptions with stakeholders, and document the behaviour that has never been written down.
    • Write well-structured user stories, functional descriptions and acceptance criteria, following the team’s established documentation standards, and keep them current as decisions change.
    • Walk the development and QA team through each feature, stay available during implementation and confirm that what was delivered answers the original business need.
    • Analyse edge cases, dependencies and cross-module impact before development starts, and challenge requests that are unclear, contradictory or unlikely to deliver the expected value.
    • Create basic wireframes and UI mockups to illustrate feature concepts and support developer hand-off.
    • Support QA by reviewing test scenarios against the documented acceptance criteria.

    Requirements

    • 3+ years of hands-on experience as a Business Analyst on software development projects.
    • Strong requirements analysis and documentation skills: the ability to translate vague business needs into clear, structured specifications, including functional and non-functional requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria.
    • Proven ability to work independently with stakeholders: you dig into a vague request, ask the uncomfortable questions and keep going until the real need is clear.
    • Strong attention to detail, including edge cases, permissions, validation rules and alternative flows.
    • Strong command of English at B2 level or above. Written documentation is the primary deliverable, and stakeholder communication is daily.
    • Strong proficiency with generative AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT or similar) for accelerating documentation, analysis and research tasks.
    • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodology and with tools such as Azure DevOps and Confluence; basic wireframing skills in Figma, Balsamiq or similar.

    Nice to have

    • Experience with e-commerce platforms, checkout flows or digital retail is a strong plus.
    • Exposure to accessibility standards (WCAG) or to admin and back-office systems is a plus. The audience of the store includes people with disabilities, so accessibility is treated seriously; this knowledge can also be built up on the project.
    • Experience on projects that migrate a legacy system to a modern stack.
    • Experience documenting reports and back-end logic is a plus.

    Team
    You will be part of a collaborative, cross-functional team that includes four developers, two QA Engineers with automation expertise, a Project Manager, and two Business Analysts. The development team includes dedicated Front-End and Back-End Engineers.

    You will also work directly with the client’s Software Director and in-house Business Analyst, with regular opportunities to collaborate with Marketing, Merchandising, and other business teams.

    Schedule

    Full-time, remote, 40 hours per week, 5/2. The start of the day is flexible; the working day is planned so that it overlaps with the client in the US Eastern time zone, with calls typically taking place in the afternoon and early evening Kyiv time.

    Hiring process
    Interview with the recruiter, then one joint interview with the project manager and the current business analyst (about 1.5 hours, including practical cases).

    We offer

    • B2B contract, paid sick leave and 20 days of paid vacation
    • Official Ukrainian holidays are non-working days
    • Flexible work schedule and remote work
    • Free English lessons, paid courses and certifications
    • Career development plan and mentoring
    • Coach and psychologist consultations, workshops
    • Medical health insurance

    Why this role is worth your attention

    This is a large, living product with real growth ambitions, and the analyst sees all of its levels: from the storefront a customer uses to the internal processes that keep orders, suppliers and service moving. There is a substantial backlog and a clear modernisation roadmap, so the work is varied rather than repetitive.
    The client is reasonable and collaborative, meetings are scheduled around the team, and the analyst’s opinion genuinely influences what gets built. The role suits someone who prefers to shape the solution rather than pass requirements along, and who is comfortable taking ownership of a domain over time.
